lessons: When generating a standalone HTML dashboard, always embed all CSS inline and avoid any external dependencies.
When responding to code-generation requests, provide the complete solution exactly in the format specified and never truncate it.
Always provide a complete, self-contained HTML file with all necessary inline CSS to fully implement the requested features.
Always deliver the requested technical architecture analysis in structured markdown, covering the topics specified in the directive.
When generating quick web tools, produce a single‑file HTML application with all CSS and JavaScript embedded inline.
